name: Suzhou SLAC Precision Equipment CO.,Ltd.
summary: Suzhou SLAC Precision Equipment CO.,Ltd. researches, designs, produces, assembles, and debugs high-speed easy-open lid and easy-open can metal packaging product production equipment in China and internationally. The company offers high speed EOE line equipment, such as high speed shell system and conversion system; high speed 2- pieces can line equipment, which include cupper system, bodymaker, trimmer, offset printer, digital printer, inside coater, necker, and palletizer; inspection systems, comprising version inspection system, can vacuum tester, digital printing inspection system, light leakage inspection system, score residual measuring device, and battery case visual inspection system;…
